name: Absolution
description: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

name: Absolution of Inspiring
description: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

name: Added Chaos Damage Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Added Cold Damage Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Added Fire Damage Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Added Lightning Damage Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Additional Accuracy Support
description: Supports attack skills.

name: Advanced Traps Support
description: Supports skills which throw traps.

name: Alchemist's Mark
description: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time.

name: Ambush
description: Teleports you to a nearby enemy, applying a buff to you for a short duration and blinding the enemy for a secondary duration. Performing a melee attack with a One-Handed Weapon removes the buff to exert that attack.

name: Ancestral Call Support
description: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

name: Ancestral Cry
description: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent strike attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that  grants elemental resistances.

name: Ancestral Protector
description: Summons an Ancestor Totem which attacks enemies with melee strikes while you're near it. Being near it grants you more attack speed. Requires a Melee Weapon or Unarmed.

name: Ancestral Warchief
description: Summons an Ancestor Totem which attacks enemies with a powerful slam while you're near it. Being near it grants you more melee damage. Requires a Melee Weapon or Unarmed.

name: Anger
description: Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.

name: Animate Guardian
description: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.

name: Animate Guardian of Smiting
description: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side using Smite of Divine Judgement, ignoring weapon restrictions. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.

name: Animate Weapon
description: Animates a Melee Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.

name: Animate Weapon of Ranged Arms
description: Animates a Ranged Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.

name: Animate Weapon of Self Reflection
description: Animates a copy of your main hand Melee Weapon to fight by your side. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps or Mines.

name: Annihilation Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Arc
description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

name: Arc of Oscillating
description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further.

name: Arc of Surging
description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies.

name: Arcane Cloak
description: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

name: Arcane Surge Support
description: Each supported spell will track how much mana you spend on it, granting a buff when the total mana spent reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, mines or skills with a reservation.

name: Arcanist Brand
description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

name: Archmage Support
description: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Arctic Armour
description: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary.

name: Armageddon Brand
description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

name: Armageddon Brand of Recall
description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

name: Armageddon Brand of Volatility
description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.

name: Arrogance Support
description: Supports any non-blessing skill with a reservation.

name: Arrow Nova Support
description: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

name: Artillery Ballista
description: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.

name: Artillery Ballista of Cross Strafe
description: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.

name: Artillery Ballista of Focus Fire
description: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.

name: Assassin's Mark
description: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

name: Autoexertion
description: Reserves mana based on the supported warcries to cause those warcries to be repeatedly triggered.

name: Automation
description: While this skill is active, supported spells will be repeatedly triggered.

description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Awakened Added Cold Damage Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Awakened Added Fire Damage Support

description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Awakened Blasphemy Support
description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

name: Awakened Brutality Support
description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

name: Awakened Burning Damage Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.

name: Awakened Cast On Critical Strike Support
description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Awakened Cast While Channelling Support
description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Awakened Chain Support
description: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

name: Awakened Cold Penetration Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

name: Awakened Controlled Destruction Support
description: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

name: Awakened Deadly Ailments Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Awakened Elemental Damage with Attacks Support
description: Supports attack skills.

name: Awakened Elemental Focus Support
description: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

name: Awakened Empower Support
description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the level of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

name: Awakened Enhance Support
description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

name: Awakened Enlighten Support
description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

name: Awakened Fire Penetration Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.

name: Awakened Fork Support
description: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

name: Awakened Generosity Support
description: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Awakened Greater Multiple Projectiles Support
description: Supports projectile skills.

name: Awakened Hextouch Support
description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

name: Awakened Increased Area of Effect Support
description: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

name: Awakened Lightning Penetration Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.

name: Awakened Melee Physical Damage Support
description: Supports melee attack skills.

name: Awakened Melee Splash Support
description: Supports melee strike skills, causing their melee strike to deal splash damage around each target hit.

name: Awakened Minion Damage Support
description: Supports skills which create Minions.

name: Awakened Multistrike Support
description: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

name: Awakened Spell Cascade Support
description: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Awakened Spell Echo Support
description: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

name: Awakened Swift Affliction Support
description: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.

name: Awakened Unbound Ailments Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments

name: Awakened Unleash Support
description: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Awakened Vicious Projectiles Support
description: Supports projectile attack skills.

name: Awakened Void Manipulation Support
description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

name: Ball Lightning
description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

name: Ball Lightning of Orbiting
description: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

name: Ball Lightning of Static
description: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems.

name: Ballista Totem Support
description: Supports any bow or wand attack skill, causing it to summon a ballista totem that uses the skill for you.

name: Bane
description: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Bane of Condemnation
description: Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Barrage
description: After a short preparation time, you fire individual projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.

name: Barrage of Volley Fire
description: After a short preparation time, you fire projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.

name: Barrage Support
description: Supports projectile attack skills that use bows or wands. Cannot support triggered skills, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

name: Battlemage's Cry
description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that boosts critical strike chance.

name: Bear Trap
description: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

name: Bear Trap of Skewers
description: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

name: Behead Support
description: Supports strike skills.

name: Berserk
description: Consumes Rage at an accelerating rate to increase the effects of Rage.

name: Blade Blast
description: Deals spell damage in a targeted area. Each time this spell deals damage,  it will detonate any of your Lingering Blades it touches, dealing damage again in an area around them. Up to 50 Blades can be detonated this way.

name: Blade Blast of Dagger Detonation
description: Deals spell damage in an area around you. Your equipped daggers add to this damage.

name: Blade Blast of Unloading
description: Deals spell damage in an area around you. If you have Blade Vortex blades orbiting you, it will detonate each of them in turn, dealing damage again in an area around you for each one.

name: Blade Flurry
description: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

name: Blade Flurry of Incision
description: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The critical strike chance is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

name: Blade Vortex
description: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.

name: Blade Vortex of the Scythe
description: This spell creates a swarm of ethereal blades which briefly orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius.

name: Bladefall
description: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

name: Bladefall of Impaling
description: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

name: Bladefall of Trarthus
description: Once activated, continuously spends mana to cause volleys of ethereal weapons rain from the sky around you, dealing damage to enemies they impact. Each Blade will target a separate enemy in the volley area if possible. Each enemy can only be hit once by each volley, even if multiple blades land near them. This skill cannot be triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Bladefall of Volleys
description: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider and more damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

name: Bladestorm
description: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

name: Bladestorm of Uncertainty
description: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a random bladestorm. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe.

name: Blasphemy Support
description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

name: Blast Rain
description: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.

name: Blast Rain of Trarthus
description: Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff.

name: Blastchain Mine Support
description: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a mine that will use the skill for you when you detonate it. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

name: Blazing Salvo
description: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.

name: Blessed Call Support
description: Supports Warcries that are not triggered. Supported Warcries create Consecrated Ground, but have lowered area of effect and cooldown recovery.

name: Blight
description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

name: Blight of Atrophy
description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

name: Blight of Contagion
description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion.

name: Blind Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Blink Arrow
description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

name: Blink Arrow of Bombarding Clones
description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

name: Blink Arrow of Prismatic Clones
description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

name: Block Chance Reduction Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Blood and Sand
description: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.

name: Blood Offering
description: Consumes a corpse, and sacrifices a portion of your life, granting your minions life regeneration based on the life sacrificed, and a bonus to damage. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration and life regeneration for each corpse consumed.

name: Blood Rage
description: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge.

name: Bloodlust Support
description: Supports melee attack skills, causing them to deal more damage against bleeding enemies, but preventing those skills from inflicting bleeding on enemies in any way.

name: Bloodsoaked Banner Support
description: Supports banner skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Bloodthirst Support
description: Supports attack skills. Cannot support triggered skills, skills which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps or mines.

name: Bodyswap
description: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

name: Bodyswap of Sacrifice
description: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

name: Bone Offering
description: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

name: Bonechill Support
description: Supports any skill that can chill enemies or create chilling areas.

name: Boneshatter
description: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

name: Boneshatter of Carnage
description: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

name: Boneshatter of Complex Trauma
description: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

name: Bonespire Support
description: Supports warcry skills you use yourself.

name: Brand Recall
description: Recall your brands to you, detaching them from enemies and increasing attachment range until they next attach to an enemy. Spends a portion of each recalled brand's cost to cause it to activate.

name: Brutality Support
description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

name: Burning Arrow
description: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

name: Burning Arrow of Vigour
description: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

name: Burning Damage Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.

name: Call the Pyre
description: When you Attack with this Graft equipped, it will call forth pillars of ashen flame. These pillars deal Fire damage in an area, and cover Enemies they hit in Ash.

name: Cast On Critical Strike Support
description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Cast on Death Support
description: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when you die. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Cast on Melee Kill Support
description: Must support both a melee attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it kills an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Cast on Ward Break Support
description: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when your Ward breaks. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Cast when Damage Taken Support
description: Each supported spell skill will track damage you take, and be triggered when the total damage taken reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Cast when Stunned Support
description: Each supported spell skill will have a chance to be triggered when you are stunned. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Cast while Channelling Support
description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

name: Caustic Arrow
description: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

name: Caustic Arrow of Poison
description: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact.

name: Chain Hook
description: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.

name: Chain Hook of Angling
description: Cast your fishing rod towards a number of enemies in front of you. Non-unique enemies far away from you are pulled towards you.

name: Chain Hook of Trarthus
description: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.

name: Chain Support
description: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

name: Chance to Bleed Support
description: Supports attack skills.

name: Chance to Flee Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Chance to Poison Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Charged Dash
description: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

name: Charged Dash of Projection
description: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

name: Charged Mines Support
description: Supports skills which throw mines.

name: Charged Traps Support
description: Supports skills which throw traps.

name: Clarity
description: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.

name: Cleave
description: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.

name: Cleave of Rage
description: The character swings both their weapons in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Requires dual wielding both an Axe and a Sword.

name: Close Combat Support
description: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

name: Cluster Traps Support
description: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps randomly around the targeted location.

name: Cobra Lash
description: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

name: Cold Penetration Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

name: Cold Snap
description: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

name: Cold Snap of Power
description: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

name: Cold to Fire Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Combustion Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Communion Support
description: Supports spell skills that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Companionship Support
description: Supports skills that create minions which can be damaged. Cannot support triggered skills.

name: Concentrated Effect Support
description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, regardless of whether that skill deals damage.

name: Conductivity
description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit.

name: Conflagration
description: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing area damage on impact and leaving the arrows stuck in the ground for a duration. If you move close to a stuck arrow, it will explode, dealing area damage and applying a fire damage over time debuff, as well as causing other stuck arrows in range to also explode.

name: Congregation Support
description: Supports skills which create Minions.

name: Consecrated Path
description: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

name: Consecrated Path of Endurance
description: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

name: Contagion
description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.

name: Contagion of Subsiding
description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before.

name: Contagion of Transference
description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy is hit while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.

name: Controlled Blaze Support
description: Supports melee attack skills.

name: Controlled Destruction Support
description: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

name: Conversion Trap
description: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.

name: Cooldown Recovery Support
description: Supports skills that have a cooldown. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Corrupting Cry Support
description: Supports warcry skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Corrupting Fever
description: Draws out your own blood to power a buff for a duration, letting this skill inflict the Corrupting Blood debuff on enemies you hit, dealing physical damage over time for a short secondary duration. The buff's duration will be refreshed if you spend enough life before it expires.

name: Coursing Current Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Crackling Lance
description: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

name: Crackling Lance of Branching
description: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

name: Crackling Lance of Disintegration
description: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you.

name: Creeping Frost
description: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

name: Creeping Frost of Floes
description: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

name: Cremation
description: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

name: Cremation of Exhuming
description: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area and detonate nearby corpses for a duration. Corpse explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

name: Cremation of the Volcano
description: Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration.

name: Critical Strike Affliction Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Cruelty Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies. Minions cannot gain Cruelty.

name: Crushing Fist
description: Retaliate against a blocked hit by calling forth a huge armoured fist to slam into the ground in front of you as you do the same, dealing weapon damage in an area.

name: Crystalfall Support
description: Supports Slam skills. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you.

name: Cull the Weak Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If normal or magic enemies are left below a percentage of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

name: Culling Strike Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If enemies are left below 10% of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

name: Cursed Ground Support
description: Supports non-aura hex curse skills.

name: Cyclone
description: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

name: Cyclone of Tumult
description: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

name: Damage on Full Life Support
description: Supports attack skills, providing a bonus to all damage dealt by those skills while your life is full.

name: Dance in the White
description: When commanded, this Graft will call forth a devastating tornado which rapidly deals cold damage to Enemies within it. When you Critically Strike with an Attack while the Tornado is active, it will fire off a nova of icicle projectiles.

name: Dark Bargain
description: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.

name: Dark Bargain of Trarthus
description: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you.

name: Dash
description: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

name: Deadly Ailments Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Decay Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Decoy Totem
description: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.

name: Defiance Banner
description: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.

name: Desecrate
description: Desecrates the ground, spawning corpses based on monsters in the current area and dealing chaos damage over time to enemies. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.

name: Despair
description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance.

name: Destructive Link
description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Determination
description: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.

name: Detonate Dead
description: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.

name: Detonate Dead of Chain Reaction
description: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with a shorter delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 8 corpses. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

name: Detonate Dead of Scavenging
description: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills.

name: Devour Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Devouring Totem
description: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you.

name: Discharge
description: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

name: Discharge of Misery
description: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

name: Discipline
description: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.

name: Divine Blast
description: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration, before blasting outwards in a larger and more damaging explosion.

name: Divine Blast of Radiance
description: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration as an orb, periodically releasing larger explosions. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which explosions occur.

name: Divine Blessing Support
description: Supports aura skills that create permanent auras around you, changing their reservation to a cost and making them temporary. Cannot support banner or stance skills.

name: Divine Ire
description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages.

name: Divine Ire of Disintegration
description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages.

name: Divine Ire of Holy Lightning
description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages.

name: Divine Retribution
description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a surge of divine power, causing multiple waves of lightning bursts to expand outward from a targeted location. This skill cannot be Triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Divine Sentinel Support
description: Supports skills that create sentinel minions, causing those minions to be created with a beneficial templar aura.

name: Dominating Blow
description: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.

name: Dominating Blow of Inspiring
description: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.

name: Double Strike
description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

name: Double Strike of Impaling
description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

name: Double Strike of Momentum
description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, gaining stages which cause this skill to attack faster. All stages are lost when you move.

name: Dread Banner
description: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.

name: Dual Strike
description: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

name: Dual Strike of Ambidexterity
description: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Requires dual-wielding two different melee weapon types to use.

name: Earthbreaker Support
description: Supports slam skills, causing them to summon an ancestor totem that uses the skill for you while you're near it. Being near it grants you increased area of effect for melee skills.

name: Earthquake
description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

name: Earthquake of Amplification
description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

name: Earthshatter
description: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near any spike will cause them to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

name: Earthshatter of Fragility
description: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

name: Earthshatter of Prominence
description: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

name: Edify Support
description: [DNT] Supports bla

name: Efficacy Support
description: Supports any skill that deals damage or has a duration.

name: Eldritch Blasphemy Support
description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

name: Elemental Army Support
description: Supports skills which create Minions.

name: Elemental Damage with Attacks Support
description: Supports attack skills.

name: Elemental Focus Support
description: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

name: Elemental Hit
description: Each attack with a melee weapon will choose an element at random, and will only be able to deal damage of that element. If the attack hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them, with the radius being larger if that enemy is suffering from an ailment of the chosen element. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

name: Elemental Hit of the Spectrum
description: Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them.

name: Elemental Penetration Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

name: Elemental Proliferation Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or could otherwise apply elemental ailments.

name: Elemental Weakness
description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.

name: Empower Support
description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the level of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

name: Endurance Charge on Melee Stun Support
description: Supports melee attack skills.

name: Enduring Cry
description: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges.

name: Energy Blade
description: Grants a buff which significantly lowers your maximum Energy Shield to transform your equipped swords into swords formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. This skill cannot be triggered or used with non-sword weapons.

name: Energy Leech Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech energy shield based on damage dealt.

name: Enervating Grasp
description: When commanded, this Graft will summon forth a field of grasping hands, each of which clutches an enervating orb of Lightning. When an Enemy is near a hand, the orb it clutches will detonate to deal Lightning Damage and Sap on Hit.

name: Enfeeble
description: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

name: Enhance Support
description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

name: Enlighten Support
description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

name: Ensnaring Arrow
description: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.

name: Envy
description: Casts an aura that adds chaos damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.

name: Essence Drain
description: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

name: Essence Drain of Desperation
description: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

name: Essence Drain of Wickedness
description: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.

name: Eternal Blessing Support
description: Supports aura skills that reserve life or mana to create auras around you.

name: Ethereal Knives
description: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.

name: Ethereal Knives of Lingering Blades
description:
Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
Cannot be supported by Volley.

name: Ethereal Knives of the Massacre
description: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.

name: Eviscerate
description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with an arcing slash that releases two waves of force. Enemies close in front of you can be hit by both waves. Requires a Sword or Axe and a Shield.

name: Excommunicate Support
description: Supports melee attacks. Does not modify skills used by minions.

name: Exemplar Support
description: Supports skills that create minions.

name: Expert Retaliation Support
description: Supports retaliation skills.

name: Explosive Arrow
description: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.

name: Explosive Concoction
description: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

name: Explosive Concoction of Destruction
description: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

name: Explosive Trap
description: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.

name: Explosive Trap of Magnitude
description: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it.

name: Explosive Trap of Shrapnel
description: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.

name: Exsanguinate
description: Releases several tendrils of blood from your character, targeting enemies in a narrow angle in front of you. The beams deal physical damage and inflict a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times. Effects which allow skills to chain can apply to these tendrils.

name: Exsanguinate of Transmission
description: Releases a tendril of blood from your character, which will target an enemy in front of you, then chain to other enemies. The tendril deals physical damage and inflicts a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times.

name: Eye of Winter
description: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.

name: Eye of Winter of Finality
description: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.

name: Eye of Winter of Transience
description: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.

name: Falling Crystals
description: While equipped, this Graft will periodically fling icy mortars at Enemies in range that are Chilled or Frozen.

name: Faster Attacks Support
description: Supports attack skills.

name: Faster Casting Support
description: Supports non-instant spell skills.

name: Faster Projectiles Support
description: Supports projectile skills.

name: Feeding Frenzy Support
description: Supports skills which create Minions.

name: Fire Penetration Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.

name: Fire Trap
description: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.

name: Fire Trap of Blasting
description: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

name: Fireball
description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

name: Firestorm
description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

name: Firestorm of Meteors
description: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

name: Firestorm of Pelting
description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

name: Fissure Support
description: Supports slam skills you use yourself, causing them to create fissures when impacting the ground.

name: Fist of War Support
description: Supports slam skills, providing a powerful boost when they're used, with a delay before they can be boosted again. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Only skills you use yourself can receive the boost.

name: Flame Dash
description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

name: Flame Dash of Return
description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

name: Flame Link
description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Flame Surge
description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

name: Flame Surge of Combusting
description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. If this ignites an enemy a large area of burning ground will be created under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

name: Flame Wall
description: Create a wall of fire for a duration, which deals burning damage to everything in its area. Each enemy that enters the wall also receives a secondary burning debuff which persists for a short duration after leaving the wall. Any projectiles fired through the wall by you and allies deal added fire damage and apply the wall's secondary debuff on hit.

name: Flameblast
description: Channels to build up a large explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

name: Flameblast of Celerity
description: Channels to build up an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill or automatically at maximum stages. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

name: Flameblast of Contraction
description: Channels to concentrate an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the damage of the explosion, but the smaller the area.

name: Flamethrower Trap
description: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage.

name: Flamethrower Trap of Stability
description: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage.

name: Flamewood Support
description: Supports skills which summon totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Flammability
description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit.

name: Flammable Shot
description: [UNUSED] The environmentally unsustainable child of Explosive Arrow and Flame Wall

name: Flesh and Stone
description: Buffs you, and affects nearby enemies with an aura, differently depending on your stance. Both stances are more impactful against enemies closer to you. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.

name: Flesh Offering
description: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

name: Flicker Strike
description: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

name: Flicker Strike of Power
description: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

name: Focused Ballista Support
description: Supports skills that summon ballista totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Focused Channelling Support
description: Supports channelling spells you cast yourself, significantly empowering their damage the longer they are channelled for, while also raising their cost. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Forbidden Rite
description: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your life and energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.

name: Forbidden Rite of Soul Sacrifice
description: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.

name: Fork Support
description: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first time they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

name: Fortify Support
description: Supports melee attack skills that are not triggered.

name: Foulgrasp Support
description: Supports brand skills that can be recalled.

name: Freezing Pulse
description: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.

name: Frenzy
description: Performs an attack with a ranged weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

name: Frenzy of Onslaught
description: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

name: Fresh Meat Support
description: Supports skills that create minions.

name: Frigid Bond Support
description: Supports link skills.

name: Frost Blades
description: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon.

name: Frost Blades of Katabasis
description: Attack enemies with greatly increased range, creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time if it hits. Requires a Melee Weapon.

name: Frost Bomb
description: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

name: Frost Bomb of Forthcoming
description: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

name: Frost Bomb of Instability
description: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.

name: Frost Shield
description: Place a Frost Shield that drains your energy shield for one second or until you run out, gaining stages while this drain occurs. The Frost Shield takes some damage from hits in place of you and allies while in its area. Enemies in the area are Chilled. You can only have one Frost Shield active at once.

name: Frost Wall
description: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.

name: Frost Wall of Encroachment
description: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back, with more damage dealt the more frost walls are currently active.

name: Frostbite
description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.

name: Frostblink
description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

name: Frostblink of Wintry Blast
description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

name: Frostbolt
description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.

name: Frostmage Support
description: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Frozen Legion
description: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Frozen Legion of Rallying
description: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

name: Galvanic Arrow
description: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

name: Galvanic Arrow of Energy
description: Create a burst of lightning from your Bow, firing no arrows but damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

name: Galvanic Arrow of Surging
description: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target

name: Galvanic Field
description: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.

name: Galvanic Field of Intensity
description: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.

name: General's Cry
description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user, and summoning Mirage Warriors from nearby corpses. The Mirage Warriors each use a linked attack skill once before dissipating.

name: Generosity Support
description: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Glacial Cascade
description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst.

name: Glacial Cascade of the Fissure
description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

name: Glacial Hammer
description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

name: Glacial Hammer of Shattering
description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will be a critical strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

name: Glacial Shield Swipe
description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you.

name: Glowing Silhouette
description: While Enemies are nearby, this Graft will periodically bring Lightning-Imbued Clones of you into being. These Clones will move towards the nearest Enemy, detonating and leaving behind shocked ground.

name: Gluttony Support
description: Supports Projectile Spells you cast yourself. Cannot support orb skills, triggered skills, brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by things other than you.

name: Grace
description: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.

name: Greater Ancestral Call Support
description: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

name: Greater Chain Support
description: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

name: Greater Devour Support
description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

name: Greater Fork Support
description: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

name: Greater Kinetic Instability Support
description: Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on critical strike. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Greater Multiple Projectiles Support
description: Supports projectile skills.

name: Greater Multistrike Support
description: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

name: Greater Spell Cascade Support
description: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Greater Spell Echo Support
description: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, brand skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

name: Greater Unleash Support
description: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Greater Volley Support
description: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.

name: Ground Slam
description: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

name: Ground Slam of Earthshaking
description: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff.

name: Guardian's Blessing Support
description:
Must support both a skill that creates minions which can be damaged, and
 an aura skill that creates permanent auras around you.
Cannot support triggered skills, banner skills or stance skills.

name: Hallow Support
description: Supports melee attacks you use yourself. Does not modify skills used by minions.

name: Harrowing Throng Support
description: [DNT] Supports bla

name: Haste
description: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

name: Hatred
description: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.

name: Heart of Flame
description: When you are missing Life, this Graft will apply a Buff that takes some Damage from Hits for you before being depleted. When you are struck while the Buff is active, this skill will fire a nova of fiery projectiles which explode on impact.

name: Heavy Strike
description: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Staff.

name: Heavy Strike of Trarthus
description: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Staff.

name: Herald of Agony
description: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence.

name: Herald of Ash
description: Grants a buff providing fire damage based on your physical damage. While you have this buff, if you kill an enemy, other enemies near them will be burned based on the overkill damage. The burn inflicted by this skill can only be affected by modifiers to damage over time (burning damage is damage over time).

name: Herald of Ice
description: Grants a buff adding cold damage to spells and attacks. If you shatter an enemy, this skill will cause them to explode and deal AoE cold damage to enemies near them. This damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

name: Herald of Purity
description: Grants a buff which lets you deal more physical damage. When you kill an enemy while you have this buff, this skill will summon a Sentinel of Purity, or refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. The Sentinels of Purity have a single-target melee attack and an area melee attack.

name: Herald of Thunder
description: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

name: Hex Bloom Support
description: Supports hex curse skills. Hexes from auras or cursed ground cannot transfer.

name: Hexblast
description: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.

name: Hexblast of Contradiction
